BatchQuoteRequest.description:
Inbound payload for the batch endpoint.

Cap is 25 -- matches Vexa's free-tier watchlist limit. Symbols are
upper-cased + de-duplicated server-side; the client doesn't need to
pre-normalize.

Note: ``min_length=1`` is enforced via Pydantic, but the 25 cap is
enforced in the route handler so we can return 400 (spec) instead
of Pydantic's default 422.
BatchQuoteRequest.title: BatchQuoteRequest

BatchQuoteResponse.description:
Body of the batch endpoint's ``DataEnvelope.data``.

Map keyed by symbol. Symbols that fail to resolve get a payload with
``price=None``; the entry is still present so the client can render
a placeholder cell without a separate "missing" lookup.
BatchQuoteResponse.title: BatchQuoteResponse

ConvexityScoreDTO.description:
Per-ticker convexity score row.

v3.0 populates ``ridge_score`` and ``ridge_score_pct`` and leaves the
``spy`` / ``sector`` flavors all-null. v1/v2 historical rows (queryable
via ``?formula_version=v2``) populate the flavor fields and leave the
Ridge fields null. Frontend branches on ``formula_version`` to pick
the right rendering.

coverage_status.description: Why this ticker has (or doesn't have) a ridge_score. 'covered' = score populated. 'below_cap_floor' = below the $25B v3.3 cap floor. 'no_cap_data' = stock_financials missing market_cap. 'regime_paused' = v3.1 regime gate fired. Null on v1/v2 historical rows.
coverage_status.title: Coverage Status

paused_since.description: Set when the v3.1 regime gate is active and this DTO carries the last pre-pause covered prediction as a stale fallback. The date is the first paused run. Null = not paused (or no fallback available).
paused_since.title: Paused Since

ridge_score.description: Raw Ridge composite prediction in z-score-of-forward-return units. Null for v1/v2 rows.
ridge_score.title: Ridge Score

ridge_score_pct.description: 0-100 universe rank of ridge_score for this slice. The headline 0-100 number on the ticker page. Null for v1/v2 rows.
ridge_score_pct.title: Ridge Score Pct

sector_etf.description: GICS-sector ETF for this ticker (XLK, XLF, etc.). Carried at v3.0 for reference even though the score itself is universe-wide; the sector_rank fields below compute rank within the sector cohort.
sector_etf.title: Sector Etf

sector_rank.description: 1-indexed rank within the sector_etf cohort for the same data_as_of / window / formula_version. Rank 1 is highest. None if sector_etf is unmapped or cohort < 2 tickers.
sector_rank.title: Sector Rank

sector_universe_size.description: Number of tickers in the sector_etf cohort for the same slice. Denominator for rank rendering ('27 of 73').
sector_universe_size.title: Sector Universe Size

ConvexityScoreDTO.title: ConvexityScoreDTO

ConvexityScoreFlavor.description: One estimator flavor -- either SPY-relative or sector-relative.

score_pct.description: 0-100 sector-percentile rank of convexity within GICS sector.
score_pct.title: Score Pct

ConvexityScoreFlavor.title: ConvexityScoreFlavor

CreatedWebhookDTO.description:
Includes the signing secret. Re-fetchable from GET (it is a verification
secret, not a credential), but surfaced explicitly on create/rotate.
CreatedWebhookDTO.title: CreatedWebhookDTO

DataMeta.description: Freshness + provenance metadata attached to every data response.

data_as_of.description: Timestamp of the newest data point in ``data``. For row-oriented responses this is typically ``MAX(transaction_date)``. None when the data payload is empty.
data_as_of.title: Data As Of

last_sync_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent upstream sync run for this source, regardless of whether it produced new rows. Read from ``data_sync_log.completed_at``.
last_sync_at.title: Last Sync At

regime_gate_active.description: Convexity-score-specific. True when the v3.1 SPY 60d realized vol regime gate suppressed scoring for this run (vol >= 20% annualized). False when scoring ran normally. None on non-convexity surfaces or pre-v3.1 historical rows.
regime_gate_active.title: Regime Gate Active

source.description: Stable identifier for the upstream data source, e.g. 'sec_edgar_form4'. Shown in the freshness badge tooltip.
source.title: Source

sync_status.description: Coarse health indicator: 'healthy' if recent sync succeeded, 'stale' if sync is old but not catastrophic, 'failed' if the most recent sync failed or no sync ran in the expected window, 'unknown' if we have no ``data_sync_log`` history yet, 'preview' if the service is behind a synthetic-data gate and not yet wired to a real upstream.
sync_status.title: Sync Status

DataMeta.title: DataMeta

EventData.description:
Top-level event payload. ``upcoming_earnings`` is null when no future
row exists in earnings_calendar -- Vexa renders the card as
'Next earnings TBD'.
EventData.title: EventData

dataset.description: One of the datasets from GET /datasets.
dataset.title: Dataset

HistoryData.description: Top-level response shape, wrapped in DataEnvelope at the route layer.
HistoryData.title: HistoryData

HistoryPoint.description:
One bar in the time series.

For ticker history every field is populated (Polygon aggregates are
real OHLCV bars). For portfolio history only ``t`` and ``c`` are
populated -- see module docstring for the P/L semantics.

t.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the bar's open.
t.title: T

HistoryPoint.title: HistoryPoint

NumericRange.description: Inclusive [min, max] range. Either bound can be null = open-ended.
NumericRange.title: NumericRange

PortfolioHistoryHolding.description:
One position in the portfolio. ``shares`` drives the time series
weighting (price * shares = position value); ``market_value`` is
accepted but not used in v1 -- kept in the schema for forward-compat
with the portfolio score endpoint's body shape.
PortfolioHistoryHolding.title: PortfolioHistoryHolding

PortfolioHistoryRequest.description: Body of the portfolio history POST.
PortfolioHistoryRequest.title: PortfolioHistoryRequest

PortfolioHolding.description:
One position in the portfolio.

``shares`` is included for forward-compat (per-position lots,
factor breakdown surfaces in v2) but the v1 portfolio score uses
``market_value`` only -- that's the weight, and Vexa is the source
of truth for it. We don't recompute from shares × price here.
PortfolioHolding.title: PortfolioHolding

PortfolioScoreData.description: Response data block -- the score itself + the top-5 explanatory factors.
PortfolioScoreData.title: PortfolioScoreData

PortfolioScoreEnvelope.description:
Top-level response shape.

Shape mirrors DataEnvelope[T] (``{data, meta}``) for visual consistency
on the wire even though the meta semantics are different.
PortfolioScoreEnvelope.title: PortfolioScoreEnvelope

PortfolioScoreFactor.description:
One factor explaining the portfolio score's deviation from neutral.

v1 surfaces per-position contributions only -- each factor's ``name``
is a ticker. Future versions may add synthesized factors (concentration
HHI penalty, options exposure, sector tilt). When that lands the
``name`` field stays free-form text and Vexa renders whatever's
returned without needing a client-side switch.

contribution.description: Integer points of the portfolio score (-100..+100 scale).
contribution.title: Contribution

PortfolioScoreFactor.title: PortfolioScoreFactor

PortfolioScoreMeta.description: Compute-cache meta. NOT the standard DataMeta -- see module docstring.
PortfolioScoreMeta.title: PortfolioScoreMeta

PortfolioScoreRequest.description: Inbound payload for the portfolio score endpoint.
PortfolioScoreRequest.title: PortfolioScoreRequest

QuoteData.description:
Per-ticker quote payload. ``price=None`` is the contract-compliant
shape for an unknown / unfetchable symbol -- never a 404, never a 5xx
bubble. Vexa renders ``"--"`` for null prices.

delay_minutes.description: Delay magnitude in minutes when ``delayed`` is True.
delay_minutes.title: Delay Minutes

delayed.description: True when upstream data is delayed (free-tier Polygon).
delayed.title: Delayed

QuoteData.title: QuoteData

RecentEarnings.description: One past earnings row with both estimate + actual filled in.
RecentEarnings.title: RecentEarnings

ReferenceData.description: Per-ticker reference data shape returned by ``/api/v1/reference/{ticker}``.

avg_volume_30d.description: Reserved for v2 -- not populated in v1. Computing this requires a 30-day aggregate fetch per ticker which doesn't fit the 5s budget. Return null until a nightly job populates it.
avg_volume_30d.title: Avg Volume 30D

ceo.description: Current CEO/leader name. Reserved for v2 -- Polygon TickerDetails doesn't expose this; needs a yfinance.companyOfficers sync.
ceo.title: Ceo

description.description: Priority: company_profiles.description → Massive get_ticker_details.description. Truncated to 500 chars at the service layer per spec -- long values are cut at a word boundary near 500 with an ellipsis suffix.
description.title: Description

dividend_yield.description: Source: stock_financials.dividend_yield. Returned as a fraction (0.0234 means 2.34%), per spec.
dividend_yield.title: Dividend Yield

employee_count.description: Most recent reported employee count. Source: Polygon TickerDetails.total_employees (priority) → company_profiles.employees.
employee_count.title: Employee Count

eps_ttm.description: Derived: market_cap / shares_outstanding / pe_ratio. Null when any input is missing (mostly for thinly-covered tickers).
eps_ttm.title: Eps Ttm

founded_year.description: Year company founded (earliest known founding date). Reserved for v2 -- needs a Wikipedia-derived sync. Note: this is FOUNDING year, not IPO; ipo_date is the IPO.
founded_year.title: Founded Year

headquarters.description: Headquarters as 'City, State' (US) or 'City, Country' (non-US), no street address. Source: Polygon TickerDetails.address dict -- composed from city + state_province (or city + country).
headquarters.title: Headquarters

next_earnings_date.description: Source: earnings_calendar.earnings_date -- first future row for this ticker. Null when none scheduled or ticker untracked.
next_earnings_date.title: Next Earnings Date

sector.description: Priority: company_profiles.sector → stock_financials.sector. Both nightly synced from yfinance.
sector.title: Sector

ReferenceData.title: ReferenceData

RelatedData.description:
Top-level related payload. ``related`` may be empty when no source
has data for this ticker -- empty array is the contract-compliant
response, never a 4xx.
RelatedData.title: RelatedData

RelatedTicker.description:
One related-ticker entry. Vexa hydrates name/price/dayChange via the
existing /api/v1/quote/batch endpoint, so this only carries the symbol
plus relation metadata.
RelatedTicker.title: RelatedTicker

ScreenerCriteria.description: Filter criteria. Every field optional -- absent = no filter.

altman_z_score.description: Altman Z-Score (manufacturer formula). Higher = less bankruptcy risk. Min=3 is 'safe zone'; [1.8, 3] grey; < 1.8 distress. FMP /financial-scores.

analyst_count.description: Number of analysts covering the name.

analyst_downgrade_within_days.description: EXISTS at least one analyst_actions row with action='downgrade' in the last N days. Useful as an *exclude* filter (combined with NOT semantics via the existing exclude_symbols pattern is not yet supported -- this is presence-only).
analyst_downgrade_within_days.title: Analyst Downgrade Within Days

analyst_upgrade_within_days.description: EXISTS at least one analyst_actions row with action='upgrade' in the last N days. Sourced from FMP /grades-latest-news via analyst_actions_sync.
analyst_upgrade_within_days.title: Analyst Upgrade Within Days

avg_volume_30d.description: 30-day average daily volume in shares. Useful for thinly-traded exclusion (min=100_000) or for top-of-book filters.

concentration.description: Max institutional_ownership fraction (0-1). 0.8 means 'no more than 80% institutional concentration'.

congress_traded_within_days.description: EXISTS at least one congressional (politician) trade in politician_trades with trade_date in the last N days. Mirrors the insider_buys_within_days presence semantics (>= 1 trade qualifies). Capped at 365.
congress_traded_within_days.title: Congress Traded Within Days

country.description: Set match against company_profiles.country. Values are FMP's ISO-style 2-letter codes ('US', 'CA', 'GB', etc.). Empty list = no filter.
country.title: Country

current_ratio.description: Current assets / current liabilities. FMP /ratios-ttm.currentRatioTTM. Min=1 filters to liquid balance sheets.

days_since_last_earnings.description: Days between the latest earnings_surprises.fiscal_date and today. max=14 → 'reported in the last 2 weeks'. min=60 → 'haven't reported in 60+ days' (typically pre-print window).

dcf_upside_pct.description: (sf.dcf_intrinsic_value - last_close) / last_close. Positive = DCF says under-priced. min=0.10 = 'at least 10% upside to fair value'.

debt_to_equity.description: Total debt / equity ratio. FMP /ratios-ttm.debtToEquityRatioTTM. Higher = more leveraged.

distance_from_52w_high_pct.description: (last_close - 52w_high) / 52w_high. Always <= 0 by definition. Min=-0.02 = 'within 2% of 52-week high' (i.e. effectively at new high).

distance_from_52w_low_pct.description: (last_close - 52w_low) / 52w_low. Always >= 0 by definition. Max=0.02 = 'within 2% of 52-week low'.

dividend_payer.description: True = include only payers (dividend_yield > 0). False = non-payers only. Omit for no filter.
dividend_payer.title: Dividend Payer

dividend_yield.description: Trailing dividend yield as a fraction (0.03 = 3%). yfinance convention; non-payers have null and are excluded by any range bound.

earnings_beat_streak.description: Count of consecutive positive surprises starting from the most recent quarter, capped at 4. min=4 → 'beat in each of the last 4 quarters'. min=2 → 'beat last 2'.

earnings_whisper.description: Min whisper_score (0-100; higher = more likely to beat consensus). Source: ``earnings_whisper_cache`` table populated daily for tickers with upcoming earnings in the next 30 days. Tickers off the earnings cycle are excluded. Use min=70 for 'likely beat', min=55 for 'lean beat'.

eight_k_min_severity.description: Constrain eight_k_within_days matches to rows with max_severity at or above this threshold. Values (from least to most severe): 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'. Standalone (without eight_k_within_days) defaults to a 30-day window.
eight_k_min_severity.title: Eight K Min Severity

eight_k_within_days.description: EXISTS at least one eight_k_filings row in the last N days. Combine with eight_k_min_severity to filter to material events only.
eight_k_within_days.title: Eight K Within Days

eps_growth_5y_cagr_pct.description: Forward EPS CAGR across the analyst-estimates window. Same value the existing peg_ratio_forward derives from; exposed here as a first-class filter.

eps_growth_next_year_pct.description: (next FY consensus EPS - current FY EPS) / current FY EPS. Decimal fraction. NULL when either endpoint is non-positive.

ev_to_sales.description: EV / TTM revenue. Maps to sf.ev_revenue.

exchange.description: Set match against company_profiles.exchange. Values are FMP's exchange short names ('NASDAQ', 'NYSE', 'AMEX', 'TSX', etc.).
exchange.title: Exchange

fcf_yield_pct.description: Free-cash-flow yield as a fraction (0.05 = 5%). Derived at query time as sf.free_cash_flow / NULLIF(sf.market_cap, 0); NULL when market_cap <= 0 (drops out of any bound). min=0 = 'FCF-yield positive'; min=0.05 = 'yield >= 5%'.

float_shares.description: Absolute public float in shares: shares_outstanding × (1 - insider_ownership). NULL when either input is NULL.

float_short.description: Short interest as % of float (stored in percent units; 20 = 20%). min=20 'high'; min=30 'squeeze candidate'. stock_financials.float_short.

free_cash_flow.description: TTM free cash flow in dollars. Stored absolute; common floor is min=0 for 'FCF positive'.

include_etfs.description: False = screen common stock only (drop ETF/fund rows where stock_financials.is_etf is true). True or omitted = no security-type filter.
include_etfs.title: Include Etfs

index_membership.description: Set match: ticker is currently a constituent of any of these indices. Values: 'sp500', 'nasdaq100', 'dow30'. Sourced from index_constituents (FMP nightly sync).
index_membership.title: Index Membership

insider_buy_dollar_value_within_days.description: Sum of insider_trades.total_value for BUY transactions (transaction_type='BUY', not 10b5-1) over the last 90 days. Range bound in dollars. min=1_000_000 → 'at least $1M of discretionary insider buying in the last quarter'. Window fixed at 90 days for now; can be parameterized if needed.

insider_buys_within_days.description: Include only tickers with at least one insider BUY in ``insider_trades`` filed in the last N days. Excludes 10b5-1 planned trades (lower-conviction signal). Capped at 365.
insider_buys_within_days.title: Insider Buys Within Days

insider_ownership.description: Insider ownership as a fraction of float (0-1; FMP convention).

institutional_holders.description: Min count of distinct 13F filers (CIKs) holding this ticker, sourced from whale_positions. Realistic range 0-29 in prod.

interest_coverage.description: EBIT / interest expense. Higher = more cushion. <1 = unable to service interest from operating earnings.

iv_change.description: Max iv_change_pct (current ATM IV vs ~30 days ago, signed fraction). 0 -> 'IV declining or flat'; -0.05 -> 'IV down at least 5%'. Source: ``iv_summary`` table populated nightly from ``options_chain_snapshots``. Universe today is the ~14 tickers covered by the snapshot job (SPY, QQQ, mega-caps); tickers without IV data are excluded.

last_earnings_surprise_pct.description: Most recent quarter's EPS surprise as a fraction (0.05 = 5% beat). Reads the latest earnings_surprises row per ticker via scalar subquery. NULL when no row exists (thinly-covered or fresh IPO) → drops out of any bound.

net_margin.description: Net profit margin, fraction. Maps to stock_financials.profit_margin (yfinance/FMP naming convention).

news_keywords.description: List of keywords. A ticker matches when at least one news headline in news_headlines.title (lowercased) contains any of the keywords, linked via news_ticker_map, within the trailing 14 days. Empty list = no filter.
news_keywords.title: News Keywords

pe_ratio.description: Trailing P/E (stock_financials.pe_trailing). Negative-earnings names carry negative PE; constrain with min/max bounds to exclude them (e.g. min=0).

piotroski_f_score.description: Piotroski F-Score, integer 0-9. Higher = stronger fundamentals. Min=7 is the canonical 'strong' threshold. FMP /financial-scores.

price.description: Most recent close in dollars. price_derived_cache.last_close. Use min/max to constrain ('penny' = max 5, 'sub-100' = max 100).

price_to_fcf.description: market_cap / free_cash_flow. NULL when FCF <= 0 (a row with negative FCF doesn't have a meaningful P/FCF and naturally drops out of any range bound).

quick_ratio.description: (Cash + receivables) / current liabilities. FMP /ratios-ttm.quickRatioTTM. Stricter liquidity than current ratio.

recent_filing_within_days.description: EXISTS at least one recent SEC filing -- an 8-K (eight_k_filings) or a periodic 10-Q/10-K (sec_quarterly_filings) -- with filing_date in the last N days. Presence-only (>= 1 filing qualifies). Capped at 365.
recent_filing_within_days.title: Recent Filing Within Days

recommendation.description: Analyst recommendation set match. Values mirror yfinance / FMP labels: 'strong_buy', 'buy', 'hold', 'sell', 'strong_sell'. Empty list = no filter.
recommendation.title: Recommendation

relative_volume.description: Today's volume / trailing 30d average. min=1.5 'unusual' / min=3 'breakout'. stock_financials.relative_volume.

revenue_growth_next_year_pct.description: (next FY consensus revenue - current FY revenue) / current FY revenue. Decimal fraction.

roic.description: Return on invested capital, fraction. FMP /key-metrics-ttm.returnOnInvestedCapitalTTM.

rsi.description: RSI(14) bound. Common values: max=30 'oversold'; min=70 'overbought'. stock_financials.rsi.

sector.description: Set match. Empty list also means no filter (consistent with absent).
sector.title: Sector

sma200_distance_pct.description: (last_close - sma_200) / sma_200, signed fraction. Same semantics as sma50_distance_pct.

sma50_distance_pct.description: (last_close - sma_50) / sma_50, signed fraction (0.10 = 10% above SMA50). Min > 0 = 'above SMA50'; min=0.10 = 'breakout 10%+ above'. Max < 0 = 'below SMA50'.

target_upside_pct.description: (sf.target_mean_price - last_close) / last_close. Analyst consensus target relative to current price.

upcoming_earnings_within_days.description: Earnings date in [now, now + N days]. Capped at 90.
upcoming_earnings_within_days.title: Upcoming Earnings Within Days

ScreenerCriteria.title: ScreenerCriteria

include_symbols.description: Symbol allowlist applied as a server-side ``sf.symbol IN (...)`` WHERE clause -- the positive counterpart to exclude_symbols. Semantics are deliberately three-valued: ``None`` (the default) means no filter; a NON-empty list restricts to those symbols; an EMPTY list ``[]`` matches NOTHING (0 rows). The empty-list case is what makes 'held only' correct when the caller holds nothing -- it must return no rows, not the whole universe. The browser screener never sends this directly; the session route fills it when resolving ``portfolio_mode``.
include_symbols.title: Include Symbols

offset.description: Number of result rows to skip before returning ``limit`` rows. Pair with ``total_matches`` from the response to drive client-side pagination. Capped at 10k to avoid runaway deep-paging on uncapped universes.
offset.title: Offset

portfolio_mode.description: User-relative exposure scope. Resolved ONLY by the session-authenticated route (``POST /api/screener``), which looks up the caller's holdings / watchlist and rewrites this into include_symbols / exclude_symbols before the query runs. The public API-key route (``POST /api/v1/screener``) has no user and ignores this field (no filtering, no error).
portfolio_mode.title: Portfolio Mode

symbol_query.description: Free-text search across ticker symbol + company name (case-insensitive substring). Applied to the full universe BEFORE pagination, so a match surfaces regardless of which result page it would otherwise sort onto. Scoping, not a criterion -- excluded from matched_criteria, same as exclude_symbols.
symbol_query.title: Symbol Query

ScreenerResultRow.description:
One result row.

``score`` is the convexity score percentile (0-100) -- the screener's
primary ranking signal regardless of sort_by. Vexa renders this as
the chip on each Discover card.

``matched_criteria`` echoes back the names of criteria the request
specified that are actually applied server-side (excludes reserved
fields). All criteria are AND-applied, so every result row matches
every applied criterion -- the list is identical across rows in v1
and primarily useful for Vexa to render "matched on: convexity, sector".

Display fields (Phase 1 of scanner migration, cache v8) -- populated
from the LEFT JOIN to stock_financials + company_profiles so the
AdvancedScreener2 table can render directly off the response without
a per-row /financials/snapshot fan-out. Every display field is
nullable: tickers without a stock_financials row render with "--".
Current price + SMA/52w distance deferred to Phase 3 (need a quote
store join).
ScreenerResultRow.title: ScreenerResultRow

SectorDistributionPercentiles.description: Quartile/percentile cuts of the sector cohort's convexity_spy values.
SectorDistributionPercentiles.title: SectorDistributionPercentiles

SectorDistributionSummary.description:
Aggregated distribution summary for the Vexa donut-ring surface.

Different shape from the per-row ``SectorDistributionRow`` list returned
by the internal route - Vexa's UI doesn't need the full cohort, just
where this ticker sits within it.

Two readings live side by side here at v3.0:

- ``ticker_percentile`` is the **universe rank** (0-100) sourced from
  ``convexity_scores.ridge_score_pct``. This is the headline number the
  methodology page talks about - a 75 means "higher predicted forward
  return than 75% of the universe."
- ``sector_distribution`` (p25 / p50 / p75 / p90) and ``ticker_score``
  are **sector-cohort context**. Quartile cuts of the raw ridge_score
  values within the ticker's GICS-sector peer group, plus this ticker's
  raw score. Useful for "your ticker sits at +0.04 vs sector median
  of +0.01" framing alongside the universe rank.

Both readings come from the same nightly run. v1/v2 historical reads
(via ?formula_version=v2) fall back to convexity_spy + score_spy_pct.

sector.description: GICS sector name (e.g. 'Technology'). Null when the ticker is not sector-mapped (ADR, ETF, foreign listing).
sector.title: Sector

sector_distribution.description: Cohort percentile cuts of ticker_score values within the ticker's GICS sector. All-null when sector cohort is empty.

sector_size.description: Number of tickers in the sector cohort with a score for the latest slice.
sector_size.title: Sector Size

ticker_percentile.description: Universe-rank percentile (0-100). v3.0 sources from ridge_score_pct; v1/v2 historical reads source from score_spy_pct. No recomputation in the route - the value comes straight from convexity_scores.
ticker_percentile.title: Ticker Percentile

ticker_score.description: Raw score for this ticker. v3.0: ridge_score in z-score-of-forward-return units. v1/v2: convexity_spy in roughly [-1, +1].
ticker_score.title: Ticker Score

SectorDistributionSummary.title: SectorDistributionSummary

UpcomingEarnings.description: The next future earnings event for the ticker, if any.

prev_quarter_surprise_pct.description: (actual - estimate) / |estimate|. Null if either input null.
prev_quarter_surprise_pct.title: Prev Quarter Surprise Pct

time.description: Pre-market (bmo), post-market (amc), or unconfirmed (tbd). Map from earnings_calendar.time_of_day where 'BMO'→bmo, 'AMC'→amc, and anything else (TAS, '', etc.) → tbd.
time.title: Time

UpcomingEarnings.title: UpcomingEarnings

events.description: Event types to subscribe to, e.g. ['convexity_score.updated'].
events.title: Events

ticker_filter.description: Symbols to scope ticker-bearing events to. Required for high-volume events like convexity_score.updated.
ticker_filter.title: Ticker Filter

url.description: Public https URL to POST events to.
url.title: Url

info.description: Convexity's externally-callable REST surface. All routes require a Bearer API key issued from the /settings/developer dashboard. See https://convexityos.com/developers for auth, scopes, rate limits, and error codes.
info.title: Convexity Public API

post.description:
Compute the portfolio's aggregate convexity score (-100..+100).

Cache key includes the API-key owner ID + sorted holdings + day
bucket; identical requests on the same day return ``meta.source:
"cached"``. The portfolio endpoint counts as one call against the
Vexa key's quota even though it fans out N per-ticker reads
internally -- the fan-out goes straight to the service-layer query
and skips the rate-limit middleware.
post.summary: Aggregate convexity score over a holdings list.

get.description:
Latest convexity score for one ticker (public API).

Empty-data envelope is the contract-compliant response for unknown
tickers, unscored tickers, and unsupported windows - never a 404.

parameters.description: Trading-day window. Supported: (180, 252, 1260). 180 is the v3.0 headline (forward-return target horizon). 252 / 1260 stay supported for ?formula_version=v2 historical queries.
parameters.name: window_days

schema.description: Trading-day window. Supported: (180, 252, 1260). 180 is the v3.0 headline (forward-return target horizon). 252 / 1260 stay supported for ?formula_version=v2 historical queries.
schema.title: Window Days

parameters.description: Which formula version to read. Defaults to the current version. Old versions remain queryable per the methodology's public formula-versioning commitment.
parameters.name: formula_version

schema.description: Which formula version to read. Defaults to the current version. Old versions remain queryable per the methodology's public formula-versioning commitment.
schema.title: Formula Version

get.description:
Sector cohort distribution summary (Vexa §17.11 Convexity Distribution).

Different shape from the internal /api/convexity-score/{ticker}/distribution
route -- that one returns the full member list (used by the Convexity

contract-compliant empty-data behavior as the score endpoint.

Portfolio aggregate P/L history. Body: ``{holdings: [...], range}``.

Fan-out to per-ticker history is parallel via asyncio.gather and
counts as one call against the API key's rate-limit quota -- same
posture as the portfolio score endpoint. Cache key includes the
sorted (symbol, shares) tuples so identical portfolios share a slot.

Batch quote endpoint. 25-symbol cap enforced in-route so an
oversized request returns 400 (per spec), not Pydantic's default 422.

Response is a map keyed by symbol. Symbols upstream couldn't resolve
are still present in the map with ``price=None`` -- Vexa renders
a placeholder cell rather than a "missing" lookup.

Counts as one call against the API key's rate-limit quota even
though it fans out to N upstream queries; the fan-out goes through
the service layer, not the HTTP route.
